name: Entice Fey, Lesser
summary: Call a fey of up to 6 Hit Dice and offer payment for its aid.
description: Use the negotiation rules for Lesser Planar Ally, replacing the called creature with a fey of up to 6 Hit Dice. Make a Knowledge (nature) or Perform check against DC 20 plus the fey’s Hit Dice. A result of 20 or less calls nothing, and the check cannot raise the spell’s 6 Hit Die limit. The fey that answers can reject your offer. A refusal leaves the offerings and payment unspent.
components: M (500 gp in offerings plus negotiated payment)
effect: one called fey, with 6 Hit Dice or fewer
